title: Smoked Hamburger Casserole
description: A hearty casserole filled with smoked ground beef, potatoes, and a blend of cheeses. Perfect for a weeknight dinner.

ingredients.name: Potato
ingredients.amount: 2 large potatoes, peeled and thinly sliced

ingredients.name: Oven-roasted onion
ingredients.amount: 1 large onion, roasted in the oven until caramelized

instructions: In a large skillet, cook the smoked ground beef over medium-high heat until browned, breaking it up into small pieces as it cooks.
Add the roasted onion to the skillet and cook until combined with the ground beef.
In a separate bowl, combine the sliced potatoes, shredded cheddar cheese, and shredded mozzarella cheese.
Grease the casserole dish with cooking spray.
Add the potato and cheese mixture to the casserole dish, followed by the ground beef and onion mixture.
Season with salt and black pepper to taste.
Cover the dish with aluminum foil and bake for 30 minutes.
Remove the foil and continue baking for an additional 10-15 minutes, or until the potatoes are tender and the cheese is melted and bubbly.
